To find stationary points, first compute f'(x), the derivative of the function. Set f'(x) equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values represent critical points where the slope of the function is zero. Then, evaluate f(x) at these points to get the y-values. Test with the second derivative to classify them as maxima, minima, or points of inflection.
